speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; can you tell me how many days old you are and when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with midgut volvulus. This is a life-threatening emergency, especially given the patient is only six hours old with bilious vomiting. Immediate surgical consultation and preparation for an emergent upper GI contrast study are required to confirm the diagnosis and relieve the volvulus.
